title: env-source.toml
description: Root, non-secret provider context for an env-source workspace.

default_environment.description: Environment used when a command doesn't name one. Default 'development'.

output.description: Output filename written next to each .env.source. Default '.env'.

project.description: Infisical project slug — used by the REST/OIDC lane in CI.

project_id.description: Infisical project id (UUID) — used by the local CLI lane. Falls back to $INFISICAL_PROJECT_ID, then project.

api_url.description: API base URL. Defaults to the Infisical cloud.

oidc_audience.description: OIDC audience the CI machine identity expects.
